title: Cyberwave Simulation Replay Trace
description: A JSON Lines replay trace of an Isaac Sim run (and usable for MuJoCo). The first line is this header record (kind 'header'); every later line is one record whose shape is the $defs entry for its kind: command, state, lifecycle, readiness, sensor, camera_frame. A complete trace ends with a lifecycle 'stop' record. Never contains credentials or signed URLs. tolerances declares exact-match (product contract) fields and per-field numerical/image tolerances as dotted field patterns, e.g. 'state.joints.*.position'.

workload_uuid.description: Null for a run captured outside a Cyberwave workload.

renderer.description: Renderer name/version/settings, or null when nothing renders.

seed.description: Seed of every stochastic source (noise, scenario).

physics.description: Effective physics settings the plant applied (part of the replay fingerprint), or null when the runtime reports none.

substeps.description: Physics sub-steps per plant step (timestep / substeps is the solver step).

solver_position_iterations.description: PhysX solver position iterations (null when the engine has none).

solver_velocity_iterations.description: PhysX solver velocity iterations (null when the engine has none).

scene_timestep.description: Timestep authored in the scene bundle, before any per-run override.

timing.description: Effective per-run pacing and egress cadence (reported, not fingerprinted).

simulation_speed.description: Simulated seconds per wall second when paced; null when free-running.

duration.description: Scenario duration in simulated seconds, or null for an open-ended (live) run.

initial_state.description: Initial state (joint positions, base poses) per entity, or null when the runtime does not capture one.

exact_fields.description: Dotted field patterns that must match exactly (product contract), added to the built-in exact fields.

sim_time_acq.description: Simulation time the command was accepted.

sim_time_applied.description: Simulation time the command took effect.

payload.description: The existing Cyberwave command payload, unchanged.

run_id.description: Run the record was produced under. Absent means the header run; a value different from the header run is a stale-run record.

reset_epoch.description: Reset generation within the run; increments on every reset lifecycle event.

replayTraceCommandRecord.description: A command applied to the plant, in application order.

base.description: Free/floating base pose and twist (world frame, meters, radians).

run_id.description: Run the record was produced under. Absent means the header run; a value different from the header run is a stale-run record.

reset_epoch.description: Reset generation within the run; increments on every reset lifecycle event.

replayTraceStateRecord.description: A joint/base state sample at acquisition simulation time.

wall_time.description: Unix seconds; informational, never compared exactly.

run_id.description: Run the record was produced under. Absent means the header run; a value different from the header run is a stale-run record.

reset_epoch.description: Reset generation within the run; increments on every reset lifecycle event.

replayTraceLifecycleRecord.description: load, start, ready, reset, pause, resume, stop or error.

run_id.description: Run the record was produced under. Absent means the header run; a value different from the header run is a stale-run record.

reset_epoch.description: Reset generation within the run; increments on every reset lifecycle event.

replayTraceReadinessRecord.description: A readiness milestone (e.g. bundle_loaded, physics_ready, first_sample:<id>, ready).

run_id.description: Run the record was produced under. Absent means the header run; a value different from the header run is a stale-run record.

reset_epoch.description: Reset generation within the run; increments on every reset lifecycle event.

replayTraceSensorRecord.description: A numerical sensor sample (imu, range, lidar, depth summary). Carries values or a summary; bulk arrays belong in a sidecar, not the trace.

checksum.description: 'sha256:' + hex of the frame bytes, or null.

run_id.description: Run the record was produced under. Absent means the header run; a value different from the header run is a stale-run record.

reset_epoch.description: Reset generation within the run; increments on every reset lifecycle event.

replayTraceCameraFrameRecord.description: Camera frame metadata; pixels are never inlined.

common_vector3_v1.title: Cyberwave Vector3
common_vector3_v1.description: Three numbers with named components. The keys carry the meaning, so key order is irrelevant and an array is never used. The enclosing field names the quantity and its unit (a position in metres, a linear velocity in metres per second, a size as extents along the world axes). The same x, y, z as protobuf geometry.v1.Vector3 and as the Vector3 in cyberwave-robot-format and the Python SDK.

common_quaternion_v1.title: Cyberwave Quaternion
common_quaternion_v1.description: A rotation as a quaternion with named components, listed x, y, z, w as in protobuf geometry.v1.Quaternion. The keys carry the meaning, so key order is irrelevant and the xyzw/wxyz question never arises in JSON; an array is never used. A rotation is expected to have unit length; the schema cannot say so, and writers that care check the norm with cyberwave_geometry.
